notes: Items the designer added to the approved round-2 frames under the density decision (2026-10-08), not in the clay. 'Replace' = fill the slot with 3 sold products that pass the quality gate; the slot itself stays (removing it would break the density floor in MB0 and C0). Card counts as of 2026-10-10 (data/products/**, data/leads/slot-gaps-2026-10-09.txt, rounds 6-8). Business thresholds are a proposal, open for the user. The kitchen slots live in data/slots/dining-room.json (there is no kitchen*.json).
quality_gate: At least 3 cards in the slot envelope (+-15%) with style_scores.nordic >= 8, images.quality high, images.usage_rights confirmed, Israel shipping; until then the slot keeps its approved designer spec.

business_gates.now: No business gate: sourcing is active now (rule ג.9), because of exposure.
business_gates.B20: Dedicated sourcing effort (CJ Sourcing request, Yakkyofy, EU/IL supplier, per S1/S3) once the room's products reach 20 orders a month (proposal, aligned with E1 20-30 units).
business_gates.B50: Dedicated sourcing effort once the room's products reach 50 orders a month (proposal). Until then only passive sourcing (cards found by the ongoing rounds).
